# Gustavo Sebold

> Personal site of Gustavo Sebold, a senior full-stack developer from Curitiba, Brazil, who builds performant, accessible web applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js/NestJS and .NET. The site is a single page, available in English and Brazilian Portuguese, covering his work experience, skills and how to contact him.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://gsebold.com/en): Introduction, work experience, skills and contact form
- [Home (Português)](https://gsebold.com/pt): The same page in Brazilian Portuguese

## Experience

- Senior Full Stack Developer at RFA Mortgage (Sep 2024 – present): React and Next.js front ends on RESTful APIs, scalable front-end architecture, NestJS and .NET endpoints following Clean Architecture, headless CMS (Directus) integration
- Full Stack Developer at Wise Systems (Jan 2024 – Aug 2024): React and NestJS, GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL and MongoDB
- Full Stack Developer at D18 (Jan 2022 – Dec 2023): Ruby on Rails back ends, Vue.js admin dashboards, HTML/CSS/JavaScript interfaces, CI/CD on Heroku, legacy modernization
- Intern at SSW Sistemas (May 2021 – Nov 2021): Object Pascal back ends, RESTful APIs, EDI integrations, PostgreSQL tuning

## Skills

- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, React Router
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, C#, .NET
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MongoDB
- Tools: Docker, Git, GitHub, Power BI, Railway, Vite
